correctness.rationale: A direct six-coordinate matrix-unit calculation reduces [X,Y]=w to two independent linear determinants and one linear functional. The projected fiber count H_q(u,v)=q^2(q^2-1)+q^4 1_{u=v=0}; the third functional degenerates exactly on q^2 projected sextuples, yielding the three stated fiber sizes, global sum q^12, and positivity. A separate adjoint-rank count reproduces the zero fiber. Full matrix multiplication was exhaustively checked for all ordered pairs for q=2,3,4 (4096; 531441; 16777216), and projected counts plus ranks independently checked for q=2,3,5. All verification programs completed with VERIFY_OK; finite tests supplement a proof valid for all prime powers.

originality.rationale: The assessed contribution is the full nonzero additive commutator fiber stratification on the first non-Heisenberg strictly triangular algebra. The same-object centralizing-map work does not count fixed values; the unitriangular-group branching work covers the commuting locus (zero value) but not nonzero additive outputs. Broader full-matrix commuting-pair results and Kronecker path-algebra fiber results do not imply the nonzero formulas. A specific undiscovered stronger theorem remains a publication-priority risk.
residual_risks: Publication priority is provisional; no exhaustive survey of all special-nilpotent-matrix word-map papers or unindexed tables was possible.

The multiplicative group commutator of UT4 differs from the additive algebra commutator; a nontrivial equivalence or previously tabulated character-theoretic formula could possibly reproduce this nonzero distribution.
The zero fiber for odd fields is already implied by published UT4 commuting probabilities and is expressly not claimed as separately novel.

value.rationale: Counts an exact natural word-map invariant, not an arbitrary specialized slice: all values and all ordered input pairs of the first three-step strictly upper-triangular algebra. Reveals a structurally explained factor-of-two distinction between central and noncentral nonzero values and a singular zero fiber in every finite characteristic. This complete classification can serve as a benchmark for three-step nilpotent algebra and Lie word-map distributions; value does not rely on an unproved generalization.
